question: Should LongCat be accepted as a bundled provider plugin in OpenClaw core, shipped first as an official external ClawHub provider, or left as documented custom-provider configuration?
rationale: The provider SDK can support LongCat, but adding provider auth, onboarding, catalog, docs, and env/config surface is a product and ownership decision under the repo's lean-core plugin policy.

options.title: Bundle after PR review
options.body: Accept LongCat as a bundled provider once the linked draft PR resolves review blockers and provides the agreed contract/live validation.

options.title: External provider first
options.body: Move the same provider shape to an official external or ClawHub package and consider bundling later if demand and ownership justify it.

options.title: Keep custom config only
options.body: Do not add an official LongCat plugin yet and rely on the documented models.providers workaround until demand or validation improves.

recommendation.title: Bundle after PR review
recommendation.body: Accept LongCat as a bundled provider once the linked draft PR resolves review blockers and provides the agreed contract/live validation.
